summary: Recent updates to the Media sink component of Firefox have focused on improving how audio streams are handled during playback. By **reusing audio streams across seeks** (when you jump forward or backward in a video), the browser can provide a smoother experience without interruptions or the need to recreate the audio from scratch. Additionally, these changes ensure that if an audio stream unexpectedly stops working, a new one can be created seamlessly when resuming playback. These enhancements contribute to more reliable and responsive audio playback, making your online viewing experience more enjoyable.
